The owner gave one or two as a starting answer and said explicitly that he expects the set to move on research coming back.

question: Which recurring dispositions show up often enough in ordinary life to be worth modelling as traits, and how many is the right number before they stop being distinguishable from each other in play?

sourcesChecked.whatItDidNotSettle: Sociability, deliberation, reliability, conflict and risk. They were an authored first-playable set rather than a researched one, and nothing in the repository records why those five or why five.

sourcesChecked.source: The four decisions in the game that currently read a trait at all
sourcesChecked.whatItDidNotSettle: Only three of the five are read by anything, and the load report says so on purpose. That tells us which are currently connected, not which are worth having.

title: Which traits an ordinary life needs, and how many
usableAnswer: A proposed set with a sentence each on what it governs and what it would visibly change about how a character behaves. Overlaps with the current five called out explicitly, including any of the five that should be dropped or merged. A rough ceiling on how many a player can actually tell apart is more useful than an exhaustive list.
whyItMatters: The owner has said he wants this to be modder-friendly in the way RimWorld and The Sims are, and the shipped set is the example every pack author copies. A set that is really three traits and two synonyms teaches the wrong shape to everybody who extends it, and the wrong shape is far harder to walk back than the wrong count.

answer.summary:
Retain the five underlying temperament dimensions. The previously delivered 121-candidate, 14-family catalogue is the research vocabulary; do not replace it with another arbitrary ceiling or silently make all 121 separate latent axes. Several named descriptors can be meaningful combinations or distinct additional tendencies. Skills, interests, temporary feelings and goals remain separately meaningful attributes of the same person.

Implement families in complete behavioral groups rather than all labels before any effect. Every added descriptor needs at least a clear meaning and nearest-neighbor distinction, a supported decision effect, an expression effect, a context where it should not matter, and interaction with other traits. 'Studious' is effort in acquiring knowledge, not knowledge granted at generation; 'cocky' is not competence; 'brazen' is not every kind of risk.

The inspected people-mind pack explicitly admits only life:ordinary scope. Extend the appropriate shared trait registration and existing decision adapters so the same person's traits can inform workplace, civic and governing contexts. Do not create a second legislative personality to replace their ordinary identity or bypass scoped admission accidentally. Scope controls relevance, not the existence of a different person in each room. No trait guarantees another person's agreement.

Acceptance ChatGPT requests (not executed): Follow one person from a work conversation to a public-role negotiation: identity and trait evidence stay the same, with context-specific goals/authority and different relevant considerations. A trait without a supported consumer is reported as unconnected, not counted as finished depth.
